source.content: @isTest private class DataDatabaseDeleteUndeleteObjectSystemModeRuntimeTest { @isTest static void objectOverloadsRunInSystemMode() { Account a1 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Access'); Account a2 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Access'); insert new List<Account>{a1, a2}; List<SObject> list1 = new List<SObject>{a1, a2}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(list1, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.undelete(list1, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); Account a3 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Both'); Account a4 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Both'); insert new List<Account>{a3, a4}; List<SObject> list2 = new List<SObject>{a3, a4}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(list2, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.undelete(list2, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); Account a5 = new Account(Name = 'Delete Object Access'); insert a5; Object object1 = a5; System.assert(Database.delete(object1, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).isSuccess()); Account a6 = new Account(Name = 'Undelete Object Access'); insert a6; Object object2 = a6; delete a6; System.assert(Database.undelete(object2, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).isSuccess()); } }
